coaching.phase1: Reply bait > like bait. Ask a question that can't be ignored. Post when your audience is active — first 6 hours are your entire window.
coaching.phase2: Reply to every comment in the first hour. A reply from a mutual follow ≈ 30 likes in X's published weights; a copy-link share ≈ 30 likes.
coaching.phase34: Links are fine in the main post since Jul 2026 — lead with a native hook. Build content people copy-link and DM. Conversation depth is everything on X.
